name: Hugo Open-Source Static Site Generator
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source static site generator for building Markdown/content-driven websites locally; no vendor-imposed build, page or site quota.
watch_out: Hugo is build software, not a free hosted website or CDN. Hosting, domains, bandwidth, CI runners and cloud storage may cost money; themes and extensions can have separate licenses. Preserve Apache-2.0 notices.
